heading: Today
text: Patchy dense fog early.  Becoming mostly sunny, mixed with some clouds near the mountains.  Cooler.  Highs from the low 60s to low 70s north to south.  Winds northwest, increasing to 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, mixing with periods of clouds overnight.  Chilly, with areas of dense river valley fog.  Some isolated frost in the cold spots.  Lows in the upper 30s to low 40s, low 30s in the cold spots north.  Winds north 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the evening, diminishing to light and variable later tonight.

heading: Saturday
text: Areas of valley fog burning off by mid-morning.  Mostly sunny and continued cool.  Highs in the upper 50s to mid 60s.  Winds light, mainly north up to 10 mph.
